description: Preview the price of a VM configuration without creating anything. Takes the same arguments as create_vm and returns hourly/monthly cost breakdowns — use this before create_vm when cost matters.

keypairs.description: Names of SSH key pairs to install for the default login user cloud (from list_ssh_keys). Connect with ssh cloud@<public-ip>.

network.description: UUID of an existing network to attach the VM to (from networking list tools). Omit to have an isolated network created for the VM automatically. An auto-created network is removed with the VM once its last VM is deleted; a network you supply is left untouched.

networkAccess.description: Optional post-create network access configuration (egress + inbound rules on the network's public IP).

allowEgressAll.description: Create an egress allow-all rule so the VM can reach the internet.

inboundPorts.description: Inbound ports to open via port forwarding + firewall rules.

sourceCidr.description: Restrict inbound rules to this source CIDR (e.g. "203.0.113.0/24").

tags.description: Tags to attach to the VM.

userdata.description: Base64-encoded cloud-init userdata script to run on first boot.

vmSpecs.description: VM size. Must be within the chosen package's limits (see list_vm_packages for min/max).

name: get_cost_estimate_vm
title: Get VM cost estimate
